5-8 July 2027

LISA Consortium Meeting 2027

GSSI, L'Aquila, Italy

About the meeting

The 2027 meeting of the LISA Consortium will take place at the Gran Sasso Science Institute in L'Aquila from 5 to 8 July 2027.

This page collects public information about the meeting. The detailed scientific programme, talk abstracts and slides are reserved to LISA members and will be published on the meeting Indico page.
